comment: alice solves an easy sudoku alone. Seed 1 generates the puzzle; the solution is [] until the game finishes. Malformed text and writing over a given are refused; a digit that repeats in its row, column or box is written but flagged in conflicts, and 0 clears it; the cell that completes the solution wins.
Text that is not "RC D" is an illegal_action, and the game does not move on.

body.message: want "RC D", e.g. "53 7" for row 5, column 3, digit 7 (0 clears); got "5 3 7"

comment: So is writing into a given: row 1, column 5 holds a given 8.
An 8 at row 1, column 1 repeats the given 8 in its row: both cells are flagged.
0 clears the cell and the conflict with it.
alice writes the solution into every empty cell, row by row; the last one solves the puzzle: won, solved, with the solution in the view.
Later reads keep the final view.
